description: A slow, kind, slightly raspy Polish country grandpa in his seventies speaking Polish with a natural standard Polish accent: gentle, unhurried and warm, with soft pauses, an old shepherd who loves his sheep. Clear for children, not comic, not mumbling.
text: …i Kłębuszek. Wszystkie. Dobranoc, owieczki. Bodzio jest uparty, lubi tylko mlecze… i maluchów nigdy nie bodzie. Dotrzymałeś słowa, chłopcze.
